text:
olivia: thinking out loud — we need a small UX pattern for gradual failovers that surfaces why traffic was shifted, but without spamming operators. proposals?

ben: +1. main things: short explanation, sample rate, and a link to the audit event. not a full alert for every small sample.

maria: agree. maybe notifications only when sampled fallback crosses a threshold or sustained for N mins. keep per-route bucketed.

ashwin: also add hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping. e.g. require 3 consecutive windows of >X% errors before increasing fallback sampling. then decay slowly.

leah: UX wise, in console we could show a compact banner on the route with a little pulse count and a tooltip: "Why we degraded" + top 3 signals (latency spike, 5xx, capacity). clicking expands the audit timeline.

sam: concrete telemetry question — what minimal fields do we need in the audit event so the console can show context without extra API calls? propose: {event_id, route_id, policy_id, trigger_reasons[], sample_rate, decision, operator_overrides?, baseline_model}.

olivia: can we keep payload tiny? operators will hate big blobs. maybe keep trigger_reasons as a short list of tags and a pointer to the full trace.

ben: +1. sample_policy snippet for API patch we've been sketching:```json
{
  "policy_id": "pf-123",
  "auto_fallback": {
    "enabled": true,
    "mode": "gradual",
    "sample_rate": 0.05,
    "escalation_threshold": {"window_mins": 5, "error_rate_pct": 20},
    "hysteresis_windows": 3
  }
}
```

maria: note: sample_rate should be editable at route-level and templatable by environment. and expose a "quiet_period" so we don't notify until X minutes after first fallback.

ashwin: about operator noise — ops-bot could aggregate sampled fallbacks and only open a digest if >Y unique routes triggered within Z minutes. that keeps SRE pager quiet.

leah: UI affordance: small timeline crumb on route page (green/yellow/red) + "inspect" opens audit drawer with the condensed event (the pointer to trace). show related rollout changes and model versions.

sam: one more API detail — include a lightweight boolean "explainable": true when runtime captured a short reasoning vector we can surface in UI. if false, show generic reasons.

olivia: for auditing we also need immutable records: each fallback decision should write an audit row with event_id that can be used for replay. retention policy? default 90d + enterprise longer.

maria: yep. add export hooks for privacy teams. and make sure KMS keys used for private deployments are not leaked in the trace pointer.

ashwin: ops-bot: putting a draft event schema into /specs/autofallback-events.md would help. can you generate a quick version for the console team? @ops-bot

ops-bot: auto-generated note — created /specs/autofallback-events.md draft (link: https://internal/specs/autofallback-events.md). includes fields: event_id, ts, route, policy, decision, triggers[], sample_rate, trace_url. Review requested from @leah @sam.

leah: will review this morning. small ask: add the decayed_sample_rate so console can show historical smoothing.

sam: and add a field for upstream_model_version so we can diff quality regressions across fallback events.

maria: UX follow-up — add two action buttons: "Simulate with this policy" (sandbox) and "Create incident" (prefilled). both should be careful about permissions.

olivia: sounds good. action items:
- ashwin: write hysteresis defaults and edgecases (flip-flop protection) by EOD
- ops-bot: finalize draft event schema and include decayed_sample_rate + upstream_model_version
- leah/sam: mockup compact banner + audit drawer by Wed
- maria: add notes about retention/export and privacy controls

ben: one more tiny thing — in the API change doc include examples of how to patch sample_rate via CLI/SDK to support runtime tweaks.

olivia: thanks all. keeping this small and observable is the goal. will loop back after the mockups. :eyes:
